semanticScope: AH-03 bounded public ordinary XSLT/BCAP. Adopt immutable XSLT REC https://www.w3.org/TR/2017/REC-xslt-30-20170608/ sections 2.3.2-2.3.4 (separate invocation inputs), 2.9 (errors), 3.5.6 (static parameters), 10.1.1 (result-document), and Serialization REC https://www.w3.org/TR/2017/REC-xslt-xquery-serialization-31-20170321/ existing XML/HTML/XHTML/text serializer behavior. No blanket conformance or new serializer implementation.
hostPolicy: Implement the five exact reviewed public XSLT types at the proposal hash above; ordinary principal stylesheets only. Assessor/schema/external-module/mutable resolver/listener/nonlegacy compilation refuses. Input roles must be admitted document roots. Runtime unsupported contexts/shapes throw NotSupportedException, invalid duplicate/missing capture options throw ArgumentException; compiler profile refusals return Unsupported. Existing legacy APIs unchanged.
capturePolicy: All four nonnegative count/byte caps and positive time/engine-operation caps are mandatory and copied; invocation is sole selection authority, options.Context/template/mode/base URI absent and capture RawResult=false. Linked raw/options cancellation plus inherited gate composed without weakening either. Capture uses actual serializer production, retains raw leases until serialization joins, and stages detached output/receipt diagnostics before final guards. Fresh closed resource policy per run; no external fallback. Bounds are cooperative and do not bound result construction/XPath working memory or arbitrary provider calls.
errorPolicy: Preserve identity-deduplicated original execution/serialization exceptions without flattening, including swallowed/rewrapped capture failures. Admission/work/cleanup objects route directly through TA-31 and retain ordered duplicate cleanup obligations. Overall success requires successful classified capture with no errors. Raw revocation can prevent borrowed delivery while owned run retains staged diagnostics.
exclusions: No schema-aware host, arbitrary structured context, external package/module/resource acquisition, public hard sandbox, owner/native/performance/budget/C45/freeze/package/publication acceptance. SchemaAtomics and other accepted requirements remain unwaived.
